Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by global instability. French unrest is sparking broader debt fears, which could hit risk assets like your tech/chip names. Meanwhile, specific chip sector news out of China isn't helping sentiment.

Your holdings: SMH is right at its stop at 540, currently -15.18% down. SOXL is deep in the red at -58.32%, and SMCI is down -27.92%; both are "SELL" status. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on how the broader market reacts to the French debt crisis fears. Also, watch for any further weakness in the chip sector following the China CXMT news.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your existing risk, especially those positions at or near their stops, given the current market headwinds.
plays: SMH: Your stop at 540 is critical; consider trimming or exiting if it breaks decisively below this level.
SOXL & SMCI: These are deep in the red and "SELL" status. Review your conviction and risk tolerance, especially with SOXL's leverage.
PLTU: The scanner suggests accumulating at 54.31-54.25 with a stop at 53.37. This is an existing holding, so consider adding if you believe in the setup.
